mapper.select: WITH ranked_duration AS ( SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, start_time, end_time) AS duration_seconds, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, start_time, end_time)) AS ranking_index, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_count FROM flow_instance WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND status IN (1, 2) AND end_time >= #{startTime} AND end_time < #{endTime} ) SELECT CAST(COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN ranking_index IN (FLOOR((total_count + 1) / 2), FLOOR((total_count + 2) / 2)) THEN duration_seconds END)), 0) AS SIGNED) AS median_duration_seconds, CAST(COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN ranking_index = CEIL(total_count * 0.9) THEN duration_seconds END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS p90_duration_seconds FROM ranked_duration

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN start_time >= #{oneDayBefore} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS within_one_day, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN start_time >= #{threeDaysBefore} AND start_time < #{oneDayBefore} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS one_to_three_days, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN start_time < #{threeDaysBefore} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS over_three_days FROM flow_instance WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND status = 0

WITH ranked_duration AS ( SELECT fd.model_id, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, fi.start_time, fi.end_time) AS duration_seconds, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY fd.model_id ORDER BY TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, fi.start_time, fi.end_time) ) AS ranking_index, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY fd.model_id) AS total_count FROM flow_instance fi INNER JOIN flow_definition fd ON fd.id = fi.definition_id AND fd.org_id = fi.org_id WHERE fi.org_id = #{query.orgId} AND fi.status IN (1, 2) AND fi.end_time >= #{query.startTime} AND fi.end_time < #{query.endTime} ), duration_statistics AS ( SELECT model_id, CAST(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN ranking_index IN (FLOOR((total_count + 1) / 2), FLOOR((total_count + 2) / 2)) THEN duration_seconds END)) AS SIGNED) AS median_duration_seconds, CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN ranking_index = CEIL(total_count * 0.9) THEN duration_seconds END) AS SIGNED) AS p90_duration_seconds FROM ranked_duration GROUP BY model_id ) SELECT fm.id AS model_id, fm.name AS process_name, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN fi.start_time >= #{query.startTime} AND fi.start_time < #{query.endTime} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS started, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN fi.status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS current_running, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN fi.end_time >= #{query.startTime} AND fi.end_time < #{query.endTime} AND fi.status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS approved, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN fi.end_time >= #{query.startTime} AND fi.end_time < #{query.endTime} AND fi.status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS rejected, COALESCE(ds.median_duration_seconds, 0) AS median_duration_seconds, COALESCE(ds.p90_duration_seconds, 0) AS p90_duration_seconds, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN fi.status = 0 AND fi.start_time < #{longRunningBefore} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS long_running FROM flow_instance fi INNER JOIN flow_definition fd ON fd.id = fi.definition_id AND fd.org_id = fi.org_id INNER JOIN flow_model fm ON fm.id = fd.model_id AND fm.org_id = fi.org_id LEFT JOIN duration_statistics ds ON ds.model_id = fm.id WHERE fi.org_id = #{query.orgId} GROUP BY fm.id, fm.name, ds.median_duration_seconds, ds.p90_duration_seconds HAVING started > 0 OR current_running > 0 OR approved > 0 OR rejected > 0 ORDER BY long_running DESC, current_running DESC, p90_duration_seconds DESC, started DESC LIMIT 10

WITH ranked_duration AS ( SELECT fd.model_id, ft.node_key, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, ft.start_time, ft.end_time) AS duration_seconds, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY fd.model_id, ft.node_key ORDER BY TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, ft.start_time, ft.end_time) ) AS ranking_index, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY fd.model_id, ft.node_key) AS total_count FROM flow_task ft INNER JOIN flow_instance fi ON fi.id = ft.instance_id AND fi.org_id = ft.org_id INNER JOIN flow_definition fd ON fd.id = fi.definition_id AND fd.org_id = ft.org_id WHERE ft.org_id = #{query.orgId} AND ft.node_type = 1 AND ft.is_delete = 0 AND ft.status IN (1, 2) AND ft.end_time >= #{query.startTime} AND ft.end_time < #{query.endTime} ), duration_statistics AS ( SELECT model_id, node_key, CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN ranking_index = CEIL(total_count * 0.9) THEN duration_seconds END) AS SIGNED) AS p90_duration_seconds FROM ranked_duration GROUP BY model_id, node_key ) SELECT fm.id AS model_id, fm.name AS process_name, ft.node_key, ft.node_name, COUNT(*) AS pending_count, MAX(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, ft.start_time, #{now})) AS max_waiting_seconds, COALESCE(ds.p90_duration_seconds, 0) AS p90_duration_seconds FROM flow_task ft INNER JOIN flow_instance fi ON fi.id = ft.instance_id AND fi.org_id = ft.org_id INNER JOIN flow_definition fd ON fd.id = fi.definition_id AND fd.org_id = ft.org_id INNER JOIN flow_model fm ON fm.id = fd.model_id AND fm.org_id = ft.org_id LEFT JOIN duration_statistics ds ON ds.model_id = fm.id AND ds.node_key = ft.node_key WHERE ft.org_id = #{query.orgId} AND ft.node_type = 1 AND ft.is_delete = 0 AND ft.status = 0 GROUP BY fm.id, fm.name, ft.node_key, ft.node_name, ds.p90_duration_seconds ORDER BY pending_count DESC, max_waiting_seconds DESC LIMIT 10
